title: Shima Enaga 3D
summary: 一个完全零资源的交互式3D鸟类宏观观察体验，封装在单一HTML文件中。世界内含超过15867根实例化的3D曲线多瓣羽毛，每根羽毛由多达111069个细小羽支组成，层叠于16层天鹅绒般的绒毛底层，呈现无缝圆润轮廓。环境包括金色阳光照射下有晶莹的雪覆盖的庭院、折射的玻璃温室、樱花盛开、体积光和飘雪效果。支持无碰撞穿越开启的天窗飞行，有缓慢多角度宏观镜头轨道、锐利的景深散景效果。音效由Web Audio API实时合成，包括鸟鸣、翅膀拍打及温室混响。完全由Three.js、自定义GLSL和Web Audio API通过纯数学程序生成，无任何外部模型、贴图或音频文件。
summary_en: A fully zero-asset interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single HTML file. It features over 15,867 instanced 3D curved multi-barb feather plumes (111,069 individual barbs) layered over 16 velvety down undercoat shells forming a seamless round silhouette. The environment includes a golden-hour snowy yard, refractive glass greenhouse, blooming sakura, volumetric sunbeams, and exterior falling snow. The bird autonomously flies collision-free through an open skylight with slow multi-angle macro camera orbits and sharp macro depth of field bokeh. Real-time procedural audio synthesis generates bird trills, wing beats, and greenhouse reverb. Everything is procedurally generated by Three.js, custom GLSL shaders, and Web Audio API from pure mathematics with no external 3D models, textures or audio files.
workflow_steps_en: Design procedural algorithm for instanced multi-barb feather plumes and smooth down undercoat
Develop custom GLSL shaders for feather rendering with specular and subsurface effects
Create procedural environment with snowy terrain, refractive glass greenhouse, sakura blossoms, sunbeams, and snow particles
Implement autonomous bird flight state machine with collision-free routing through skylight opening
Set up multi-pass WebGL2 rendering pipeline for refraction, depth textures, bloom, and macro depth of field postprocessing
Synthesize real-time procedural bird chirps, wing beats, ambient soundscape, and convolution reverb with Web Audio API
Integrate camera controls and hidden control panel with various toggles
Package entire experience into a single self-contained HTML file with no external dependencies

编写自定义GLSL羽毛渲染着色器，包含高光和次表面散射
程序生成雪地、折射玻璃温室、樱花、体积光和雪花效果环境
实现鸟类自主飞行状态机和无碰撞天窗穿越路由
搭建多通道WebGL2渲染流水线，支持折射、深度纹理、泛光和宏景深后处理
用Web Audio API实时合成鸟鸣、翅膀声、环境声和混响

Redesign the octopus to include 8 arms with multiple links and wheels for smoother animation.
Calculate pose each frame by traversing arm joint chains.
Animate features such as lens rotation and detachment, mantle opening with hinges, pump rotation and lifting.
Animate disassembly and quick reassembly during a 330° turntable rotation by 0:16 seconds.
Output a 25-second animation encoded in 2,616 lines of three.js code.

title: Fantasy City 3D Scene Generation with Claude and Blender MCP
summary: 这是一个利用Claude语言模型和Blender MCP插件，将灰色Blender场景转变为具有800年历史感的幻想城市的AI生成交互式世界。用户描述世界细节，如哥特式塔楼、巨大发光树和氛围，Claude在Blender中构建初始场景，然后进行多轮渲染、检查、调整灯光和材质，不断完善场景，从而使其如电影画面般逼真。
summary_en: This is an AI-generated interactive world that uses the Claude language model and Blender MCP plugin to transform a grey Blender scene into a fantasy city with 800 years of lore. The user describes details like gothic towers, a giant glowing tree, and atmosphere; Claude builds the initial scene in Blender and iteratively renders, inspects, adjusts lighting and materials, progressively refining the scene until it looks like a cinematic frame.
workflow_steps_en: User describes the fantasy world scene to Claude with details (e.g., gothic towers, glowing tree, fog)
Claude builds the initial 3D scene inside Blender using the MCP plugin
Render the scene in Blender and inspect the result
Notice imperfections or lifeless elements in the scene
Adjust lighting, materials, atmosphere, and composition based on inspection
Render again and repeat the inspection and adjustment loop until the scene feels like a real place
workflow_steps: 用户向Claude描述幻想世界场景的细节（如哥特式塔楼、发光的树、雾气）
Claude利用Blender MCP插件在Blender中构建初始3D场景
在Blender中渲染场景并检查结果
发现场景中显得死板或不够生动的部分
根据检查结果调整灯光、材质、大气和构图
再次渲染并重复检查和调整循环，直至场景如真实地方般生动
evidence_quotes: Claude + Blender MCP is the reason this gets interesting. You describe the world - gothic towers, a giant glowing tree, fog, cold stone, a lone figure with a banner and Claude can build the first scene inside Blender instead of leaving you alone with the default viewport and a mild panic attack.
Then it does the useful part: render, inspect, notice what looks dead, adjust the lighting, materials, atmosphere and composition, and run it again.
The point is not that Claude spits out one pretty image. The point is that it can keep working on the same editable 3D world until the shot starts feeling like a real place instead of a blockout.

title: Image-Blaster: Single Photo to Fully Playable 3D World
summary: Image-Blaster 是一个开源工具，它能将一张照片在五分钟内转化为完整的三维可交互世界，包括3D物体模型、静态环境、光照和环境声音，由Claude协调完成。用户将照片放入输入文件夹，Claude识别场景中的物体，生成干净的参考图像，然后调用3D生成模型生成每个物体的网格和材质，再通过World Labs构建可探索环境。支持真实照片和AI生成图像，输出不锁定，用户可以导入Unity、Unreal、Godot、Blender或Three.js继续编辑。
summary_en: Image-Blaster is an open-source tool that converts a single photo into a fully playable 3D interactive world within five minutes, including 3D object meshes, static environment, lighting, and ambient sound, orchestrated by Claude. The user drops a photo into an input folder, Claude detects objects, generates clean reference images for each, calls a 3D generation model for meshes and materials, then uses World Labs to build the explorable environment. Both real photos and AI-generated images work. Output files can be imported into Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or Three.js for further editing.
workflow_steps_en: Install Claude Code from Anthropic if not installed.
Clone the repository from /neilsonnn/image-blaster and enter the folder.
Run Claude via terminal and provide API keys for World Labs, FAL, and optionally ElevenLabs for sound.
Drop a photo into the input/ folder.
Command Claude to process the image and confirm each step interactively.
Claude extracts objects and generates clean reference images.
Send references to 3D generation models to create object meshes and materials.
Use World Labs to build a static explorable environment with lighting and ambient sound.
Obtain output files that can be imported into various 3D tools like Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or Three.js for further refinement.
workflow_steps: 确保已安装Claude Code。
克隆 /neilsonnn/image-blaster 仓库并进入文件夹。
通过终端启动Claude，提供World Labs和FAL的API密钥，可选ElevenLabs密钥。
将图片放入input/文件夹。
指示Claude执行并逐步确认操作。
Claude提取图像中的物体并生成干净的参考图。
将参考图发送给3D生成模型生成物体网格和材质。
用World Labs构建静态可探索环境，包括光照和环境声音。
输出文件可导入Unity、Unreal、Godot、Blender或Three.js继续编辑。
evidence_quotes: Feed it one image, get back a complete 3D world: 3D object meshes, a static environment, lighting, and ambient sound, all generated and assembled by Claude.
You drop a photo into a folder and Claude looks at the scene, then orchestrates a chain of models to rebuild it in 3D.
It generates a separate 3D mesh (.glb/.obj) for every object you want, builds the static room environment as a Gaussian splat, adds object-specific and ambient sound effects, and bakes in lighting.

Claude is the orchestrator. It picks objects out of your image, generates a clean reference image for each, sends those to a 3D generation model for meshes and materials, then sends the cleaned-up room to World Labs to build the explorable environment.
The output isn't locked in. It's just files on your computer, so you can drag the whole thing into Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or a Three.js app and keep building.
